questions.question: What does the observed S|AIIN versus SAIIN boundary behavior establish about a detachable/current-carry construction, separately from the proposed SAME gloss?

observed_evidence.quote:
The six-page ZL3b sample contains four exact detached `s | aiin` sequences on
three pages:

```text
f55v.10   ol    | s | aiin | okaiin
f82r.16   ol    | s | aiin | chey
f83r.10   cthal | s | aiin | chky
f83r.33   sy    | s | aiin | sheekchy
```

This is additional to five exact fused `saiin` groups. Alternate readings vary
precisely at the attachment boundary:

```text
f55v.10   S | AIIN in all three readings
f82r.16   SAIIN in IT; S | AIIN in ZL/RF
f83r.10   SAIIN or attachment to the preceding cell in IT/RF;
          S | AIIN in ZL
f83r.33   SAIIN in IT; S | AIIN in ZL/RF
```

Thus the S-AIIN relation is not inferred from substring resemblance alone.
The source boundary itself oscillates while the construction survives.

The boldest useful gloss for S is now **SAME/CURRENT-CARRY**, not a sound or an
ordinary translated word. It explains why S is favoured at physical line entry:
the new writing packet resumes a state already active in the larger record.

The repeated cross-page frame `ol | s | aiin` then receives a concrete
sidequest reading:

> For the OL carrier/object, retain the same currently registered setting.

This fits plant/biological technical prose especially well if OL is a liquid,
water, vessel content or substrate and AIIN a quantity/grade/duration. It also
remains compatible with non-liquid values.

The construction is still not proof that S always means same. S may have other
licensed functions, and the exact external content of AIIN and OL is unknown.

questions.actual_boundary_result: The exact detached/fused forms and alternate-reader boundary oscillation are observed source facts. They support a boundary-sensitive construction hypothesis, not a universal S=SAME meaning.
questions.valid_conditional_reopening: Only an independently coded state-continuation or reset endpoint, predeclared without importing the SAME gloss, could distinguish current-carry from a boundary-sensitive but semantically neutral construction. An ordinal or grade counterexample alone does not refute current-carry because the proposed card explicitly leaves AIIN quantity/grade/duration open and allows other S functions.
questions.limits: ZL3b, IT2a and RF1b are alternate readings of one manuscript, not independent witnesses. Preserve all five fused/detached source cases and do not treat boundary count as semantic confirmation.

questions.question: What did GDT759 actually change when it replaced the old s=seed family, and which part remains only a drachm working default after later quantity/attachment corrections?

observed_evidence.quote:
Die wichtigste Korrektur lautet:

```text
s aiin = saiin
Arbeitslesung: drei Drachmen
Rivalen: drei gleiche Teile | drei Unzen
```

Das ist nicht aus der EVA-Form geraten. Vier verschiedene physische Zeilen
werden über ZL3b, IT2a und RF1b vollständig identisch, sobald lediglich die
Grenze `s aiin`/`saiin` normalisiert wird. Insgesamt gibt es 23 getrennte
reader-exakte `s aiin` und 89 fusionierte `saiin`.

Damit verlassen `ein Teil Saatgut`, `Samen, Charge II`, `Samencharge III` und
`Saatgutcharge IV` die aktive Arbeitslesung. Ihre einzige konkrete
Stoffidentität stammte aus dem bereits verworfenen EVA-Initial-Mnemonic.

Warum Drachmen als Leitkandidat? Die historische Vergleichsbank belegt genau
die benötigte technische Architektur: Drachmen- und Unzenzeichen stehen mit
Werten; *ana* drückt gleiche Mengen aus. Der Drachmenmarker ist in der
abgeglichenen Rezeptüberlieferung die häufigste konsequent gekürzte
Maßformel. Das wählt eine praktische Arbeitshypothese, nicht die historische
Identität. Deshalb bleiben `drei gleiche Teile` und `drei Unzen` sichtbar.

Die grammatische Glättung fügt keine Voynich-Bedeutung hinzu; die maschinelle
Tabelle hält Menge, Stoffwert, Seite, Evidenz und Rivalen getrennt. f43v.12 ist
der ehrliche Grenzfall: oteol or aiin odain hat auf beiden Seiten eine
Zubereitungslesung. Dort bleibt offen, welcher Nachbar an die drei Portionen
gehört.

It selected drachm as a practical historical notation default while retaining equal-parts and ounces rivals. GDT760 later kept amount, material, side, evidence and rivals separate and documented bilateral attachment ambiguity at f43v.12.

questions.limits: No confirmed unit, material lexeme or universal s-family meaning follows. Preserve the 23 separated/89 fused counts, C0/C1 distinctions and later GDT760 bilateral ambiguity.
